import math

    a = math.dist(p1, p2)

    # Check for equal sides (isosceles)

    # Check for equilateral
    is_equilateral = abs(sides[0] - sides[1]) < 0.01 and abs(sides[1] - sides[2]) < 0.01
    return {'sides': sides, 'is_right': is_right, 'is_isosceles': is_isosceles, 'is_equilateral': is_equilateral}

import math

# Area of triangle: |(x1(y2-y3) + x2(y3-y1) + x3(y1-y2))| / 2
def triangle_area(p1, p2, p3):
    x1, y1 = p1
    x2, y2 = p2
